thread:
Sam: Heads up — p99 TTFT for token-level requests in eu-west2 spiked ~2.2x at 03:07. Heatmap looks like token/sec hotspots aligned with a prefix-cache cold region. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood/example/d/q1Gk-p99-token-heatmap
Maria: saw the alert too. any recent deploys/rollouts to dedicated pools in west2? :eyes:
Sam: No deploys logged around that time. ops-bot showed NAT egress spikes for west2 at 03:05.
ops-bot: alert: NAT-gateway-conns-high eu-west2 (fired) — 98% utilization 
Jin: NAT saturation would explain long tail — downstream queues back up and KV cache remote calls time out.
Priya: can we get a quick PromQL dump of the series? I want to see tokens/sec vs p99-cohort by shard.
Sam: here's a starting query I used in panel:
```
sum by (shard) (rate(redwood_tokens_processed_total{region="eu-west2"}[1m]))
/
sum by (shard) (rate(redwood_requests_total{region="eu-west2"}[1m]))
```
Sam: also pulled p99 TTFT series:
```
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(redwood_rpc_duration_seconds_bucket{job="token-server",region="eu-west2"}[5m])) by (le,shard))
```
Maria: agree with Jin — NAT + occasional noisy shard causes prefix-cache misses. We should avoid per-shard alerts; group at pool-level and annotate noisy shards.
Jin: proposal: new recording rule to compute a cache-adjusted p99 that filters requests with prefix_cache_hit==0 and exposes separate panels for hit/miss. e.g.
```
- record: redwood_p99_ttft_cache_miss:hist
  expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(redwood_rpc_duration_seconds_bucket{prefix_cache_hit="0"}[5m])) by (le, model, shard))
```
Priya: nice. That will let us reduce noise and tune SLOs independently for cache miss tail. Also propose a tokens/sec-normalized alert: trigger only if p99>1.8s AND tokens/sec/shard > 5000 for 5m.
Sam: can we get panel annotations for rollout windows so we don't get paged during canaries? I can add the grafana annotation once we have the rule names.
Maria: also put in a short-term mitigation: autoscale NAT egress or move hot shards to dedicated subnet with larger NAT capacity. Ops can we open a ticket?
Jin: filing infra ticket now — INFRA-1147: increase nat-gateway throughput w/ rollback plan. Added playbook notes in ticket.
ops-bot: ticket INFRA-1147 created by Jin — https://jira.redwood/INFRA-1147
Priya: action items: (1) implement recording rule and panel split (Maria) (2) add tokens/sec gating to p99 alert (Sam) (3) infra ticket for NAT (Jin) (4) dashboard annotation for rollouts (Sam). I'll follow up on a small RFC for the composite SLO change.
Sam: thanks — I'll prototype the alert condition in a sandbox dashboard and ping when ready. :thumbsup:
Maria: sounds good. If NAT change is slow, we can temporarily lower p99 alert sensitivity for eu-west2 and rely on tokens/sec gating.
Sam: last note: let's tag this thread with the heatmap snapshot in the ticket. saved png: /artifacts/heatmaps/euw2-1967890000.png
grafana-bot: snapshot created: https://grafana.redwood/snapshot/abc123 — expires in 7d
Sam: thanks everyone — closing thread once the recording rule is merged.
